info.title: OMS API
info.description:
HTTP API for the Kruzer Order Management System.

Authentication is required for every domain endpoint and supports two schemes: Bearer JWT (issued by the IAM service for human users) and HTTP Basic (service accounts). Public endpoints (health probes) are unauthenticated.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code emitted by the domain or application layer.

message.example: name must be at least 3 characters long

details.description: Optional structured payload (e.g. validation field errors, dependency list for EntityInUseError).

total.description: Total number of records that match the filter.

items.description: Batch de posições absolutas (1..5000). Sobrescreve onHand, blocked e safetyStock da posição.

quantity.description: Variação inteira a aplicar em onHand. Pode ser negativa (saída) ou positiva (entrada).
